limits: Heightmaps are produced by the project's own reproducible erosion simulator, not Gaea/World Machine exports; tools/prepare-heightmaps.cjs --external accepts real .r16 drop-ins
Architecture kit is procedurally authored photogrammetry-style geometry, not scanned assets; sources and licenses are in assets/ART-CREDITS.md
witness-depth.js is an evidence catalog, so water depth comes from the carved bed-height texture instead
Flora culling is per-chunk bounding-sphere frustum culling on InstancedMesh, not compute-shader indirect GPU culling
Headless browser verification on the laptop GPU; no human playtest, FPS certification or art acceptance
